messages:
alex: kicking off small change window now to add an index on events(created_at) + short compaction backfill. pinned web image to 2.15.3 for this wave. deploybot will start canary in ~3m. if we see sustained rowlock waits on events or service errors >3% abort and run rollback.

deploybot: scheduled deploy v2.15.3 -> prod (canary 3% first). migration: migrations/2026_add_events_created_idx.sql. will post updates.

naomi: quick note: the backfill uses low-priority workers but will escalate row-level locks if it hits hot partitions. db-ops, can you shadow pg_stat_activity and be ready to nudge the job downrate?

db-ops: watching. setting up a probe: `SELECT pid, state, wait_event, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ILIKE '%ALTER INDEX%' OR query ILIKE '%CREATE INDEX%';` will alert if any wait_event lasts >30s.

alex: holdpoint: any lock >30s on events OR sustained 5xxs >2% for 5m -> abort. rollback target = release-2.15.2. add rollback CLI in notes.

kev: adding rollback snippet: `redwood release rollback --to release-2.15.2 --force-if-healthy` and feature-flag toggle: `ff toggle events_index_compact false --env=prod`. will push to notes.

deploybot: canary started (ts=1781230120) at 3%. will wait 5m for stability.

naomi: canary logs look clean for 2m. DB p95 ticked to +30ms but below threshold.

pagerbot: INFO: db wait metric spike (events table) at ts 1781230245, p50 wait 12ms, p95 wait 58ms. tagging thread.

db-ops: I see one long-running backfill session (pid=44321) holding a tuple lock on events for tenant=9001. pinged owner of job. if no response in 45s will send graceful cancel to the worker.

kev: if we cancel gracefully we'll resume with smaller batch_size. command to cancel: `kill -INT 44321` from migrator host or `SELECT pg_cancel_backend(44321);` if safe.

naomi: owner replied, shrinking batch size now. lock cleared after ~22s. canary still green.

alex: proceed to 25% if no further spikes. re-check monitors and update release-notes with the exact abort checklist.

deploybot: canary bumped to 25% (ts=1781230458). next check in 10m.

pagerbot: ALERT: app errors increased to 2.7% over last 3m (ts window). still under abort threshold but trending. posting logs to: https://console.redwood/logs?query=events+index

db-ops: observed transient unique constraint violation on insert (409) for tenant 200; backfill job handled idempotency and retried. not blocking.

alex: keep a close eye. if errors hit >3% for 5m or p95 DB >250ms we flip flag and rollback. kev prepare rollback runbook in case we need to act quickly.

kev: runbook ready. steps: (1) set ff toggle false, (2) run `redwood release rollback --to release-2.15.2`, (3) pin traffic to stable pool, (4) open incident channel and call oncall. I'll be on call.

naomi: 25% steady for 7m, no locking beyond short tails. recommending proceed to 60%.

alex: proceed. final rollout scheduled for +12m unless aborted. thanks folks.

pagerbot: NOTE: will page on-call if errors >5% or db wait p95 >300ms.
